text_block_list.text:
When we meet Фудзи Кисэки's mother, we
learn that,
despite being a famous actor,
she struggles with
stage fright to this
day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки learns something important
from her
mother's words. She realizes
that what she needs
to stand on the turf
is the will to keep taking on
challenges
even if she fails.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She gains a new sense of determination.
I know in
my heart she can overcome
anything she sets her
mind to.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
